title: EXPT raises a REAL to integer exponents, zero and negative ones included, and leaves the stack as it found it
note: IEC 61131-3 EXPT(IN1, IN2) = IN1 ** IN2: 2.0 ** 8.0 = 256, any base to 0.0 is 1.0 (0.0 ** 0.0 included), 2.0 ** -2.0 = 0.25, (-3.0) ** 3.0 = -27.0, (-3.0) ** 2.0 = 9.0, an integer argument is converted to REAL (2 ** 10 = 1024) and 0.0 ** 3.0 = 0.0; twenty calls in a loop load, so a call leaves nothing on the stack
